payload.text: The governing Arabic Form 4-H (Appendix A, declaration First) defines a beneficial owner by a holding of ten per cent (١٠٪) or more. The English convenience translation (Appendix B, ADD-03:F4-H/para1) says twenty-five per cent (25%) or more. Under AppB/para1 and ADD-03:8.2 the Arabic text governs, so on the face of it each member must declare every owner at 10% or above. Bid and compliance teams working from the English text would under-declare. A clarification to the Authority may be needed. The reading of decl1 is still pending approval.
